mentions.name: Zeeq
mentions.description: Agent knowledge and observability layer for AI-assisted coding, spun out of internal tooling and open sourced (built on .NET 10 + C# + Postgres). It lifts developers using heterogeneous models, harnesses, and prompting styles to a higher level of consistency and quality, integrates the knowledge layer into the code review layer, and ties it all together with telemetry down to the document section level to show how each piece of context affects code generation.
mentions.problem: Born out of a need to lift all devs using heterogeneous models, harnesses, and prompting styles to a higher level of consistency and quality while surfacing the visibility to see what's working and what's not.
mentions.audience: Devs using heterogeneous models, harnesses, and prompting styles
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm (solo) spinning off the internal agent knowledge and observability layer used at Motion (YC W20, series C, ~40 devs). It was born out of a need to lift all devs using heterogeneous models, harnesses, and prompting styles to a higher level of consistency and quality while surfacing the visibility to see what's working and what's not. The knowledge layer is integrated into the code review layer and all of it tied together with telemetry to the document section level to see how each piece of context is affecting code generation.
mentions.author: CharlieDigital
